title: Further Instructions, Final Greetings

questions.question: Masters, treat your bondservants justly and fairly, knowing that you also have a Master in ____.
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:1 (ESV): "Masters, treat your bondservants justly and fairly, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven."

questions.question: Continue steadfastly in ____, being watchful in it with thanksgiving.
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:2 (ESV): "Continue steadfastly in prayer, being watchful in it with thanksgiving."

questions.question: Paul asks them to pray also for him, that God may open to us a door for the ____, to declare the mystery of Christ, on account of which I am in prison—
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:3 (ESV): "At the same time, pray also for us, that God may open to us a door for the word, to declare the mystery of Christ, on account of which I am in prison—"

questions.question: Walk in ____ toward outsiders, making the best use of the time.
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:5 (ESV): "Walk in wisdom toward outsiders, making the best use of the time."

questions.question: Let your speech always be gracious, seasoned with ____, so that you may know how you ought to answer each person.
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:6 (ESV): "Let your speech always be gracious, seasoned with salt, so that you may know how you ought to answer each person."

questions.question: Who will tell them all about Paul's activities? He is a beloved brother and faithful minister and fellow servant in the Lord.
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:7 (ESV): "Tychicus will tell you all about my activities. He is a beloved brother and faithful minister and fellow servant in the Lord."

questions.question: Paul is sending Tychicus together with ____, a faithful and beloved brother, who is one of them.
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:9 (ESV): "and with Onesimus, our faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will tell you of everything that has taken place here."

questions.question: Who is the cousin of Barnabas, concerning whom they received instructions (if he comes to you, welcome him)?
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:10 (ESV): "Aristarchus my fellow prisoner greets you, and Mark the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you have received instructions—if he comes to you, welcome him),"

questions.question: Paul mentions Jesus who is called ____, who is one of the circumcision party (Jewish Christians) and a fellow worker.
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:11 (ESV): "and Jesus who is called Justus. These are the only men of the circumcision among my fellow workers for the kingdom of God, and they have been a comfort to me."

questions.question: Who is "one of you, a servant of Christ Jesus," who greets them, always struggling on their behalf in his prayers?
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:12 (ESV): "Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ Jesus, greets you, always struggling on your behalf in his prayers, that you may stand mature and fully assured in all the will of God."

questions.question: Epaphras has worked hard for those in Colossae, and also those in Laodicea and in ____.
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:13 (ESV): "For I bear him witness that he has worked hard for you and for those in Laodicea and in Hierapolis."

questions.question: Luke the beloved ____ greets you, as does Demas.
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:14 (ESV): "Luke the beloved physician greets you, as does Demas."

questions.question: Paul tells them to give his greetings to the brothers at Laodicea, and to ____ and the church in her house.
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:15 (ESV): "Give my greetings to the brothers at Laodicea, and to Nympha and the church in her house."

questions.question: Paul tells them that when this letter has been read among them, they should have it also read in the church of the ____.
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:16 (ESV): "And when this letter has been read among you, have it also read in the church of the Laodiceans; and see that you also read the letter from Laodicea."

questions.question: Paul tells Archippus: "See that you fulfill the ____ that you have received in the Lord."
questions.explanation: Colossians 4:17 (ESV): "And say to Archippus, 'See that you fulfill the ministry that you have received in the Lord.'"

key_verse_text: Walk in wisdom toward outsiders, making the best use of the time. Let your speech always be gracious, seasoned with salt, so that you may know how you ought to answer each person.
